title: The Kobold Mine
text: Kobolds swarm a mine in the hillside, hauling ore for a dragon under the whips of overseers, who are whipped by bigger ones in turn. They hate it and mutter about it. When they see you they stop, looking up with a sudden, terrible hope.

options.label: Hire them away from the dragon; their hope can be put to good use.

outcomes.text: They gladly mine gold for you instead. The dragon marks the loss of its miners and does not forget it.

options.label: Free them, and let the dragon dig its own gold.

outcomes.text: They scatter, cheering. The noise wakes the dragon, who comes looking for its miners.

options.label: The shrewdest trades for their secrets, to learn what the dragon keeps.

outcomes.text: They whisper of a tunnel into the hoard, one too small for a dragon to follow.
